This is (A.47) for the explicit transformed integral `factor`, with no smoothness hypothesis at all.

snippet.text:
theorem integral_original_factorization (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (b : E × ℝ → ℝ)
    (p : E) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, (Real.exp (-c / u ^ 2) / u ^ j) * b (p, u)) =
      Real.exp (-c / x ^ 2) * x ^ (3 - (j : ℝ)) * factor c j b (p, x)
